CORPORATE
SIGNIFICANT CHANGES IN THE STATE OF AFFAIRS OF THE GROUP
Capital raising
In July 2025, ASM raised a combined $24.9 million (before costs) through an oversubscribed Share Purchase Plan,
which raised $11.86 million and closed on 17 July 2025, and a targeted Institutional Placement, which raised
$13 million and completed on 28 July 2025, both priced at $0.5647 per share.>*
In October 2025, ASM raised a further $55 million (before costs) through an Institutional Placement priced at $1.20
per share.° Uses of the proceeds included repayment of borrowings from the Korean Development Bank in December
2025.
Extraordinary General Meeting
On 23 February 2026, ASM held an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) in connection with the October 2025
Institutional Placement, seeking shareholder approval under ASX Listing Rule 10.11 for the issue of Placement shares
to directors and a substantial shareholder. All resolutions were passed at this meeting.
Dividends
There were no dividends paid, recommended nor declared during the current or previous financial year.
Energy Fuels Transaction
On 21 January 2026, ASM announced it had entered into a binding Scheme Implementation Deed with Energy Fuels
Inc. (Energy Fuels) (NYSE: UUUU; TSX: EFR).° On 13 March 2026, ASM announced that the Scheme Implementation
Deed had been amended and restated (the SID).” In accordance with the SID, it was proposed that EFR Critical
Materials Pty Ltd ACN 696 983 614, a wholly owned subsidiary of Energy Fuels, would acquire 100% of the fully paid
ordinary shares of ASM (ASX: ASM) by way of
a members’ scheme of arrangement (Share Scheme) and 100% of ASM’s
quoted options (ASX: ASMO) by way of a separate but concurrent creditors’ scheme of arrangement (Option Scheme),
both under Part 5.1 of the Corporations Act (together, the Schemes).
The consideration per ASM share to be provided by Energy Fuels to each holder of ASM Shares on the record date for
the Share Scheme was:
¢
—anamount of $0.13 cash; and
e
0.053 Energy Fuels CHESS Depository Interests (or 0.053 Energy Fuels fully paid common shares, if validly
elected).
The consideration to be provided by Energy Fuels to each holder of ASM Options on the record date for the Option
Scheme was ASO.50 cash for each ASM Option.
On 23 April 2026, the Foreign Investment Review Board (FIRB) confirmed that the Treasurer of Australia had no
objection to the proposed acquisition.®
Due to the release of material information by Energy Fuels on 18 and 24 June 2026,°° ASM and Energy Fuels agreed
to postpone the original Scheme Meetings scheduled to take place on 22 June, in order to provide updated
information to Securityholders via
a Supplementary Scheme Booklet, which was released subsequent to 30 June 2026
(see Events Since the End of the Financial Year).
